newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tateho Chem says US unit moved into black in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: Tateho Chem says US unit moved into black in 96/97.

text.p: Tateho Chemical Industries Co Ltd said on Monday that its U.S. subsidiary moved into the black during fiscal 1996/97.
It also said that its earnings outlook for the last business year, which ended on March 31, was unchanged from the forecast it announced in November.
The company said in a statement that the U.S. subsidiary's liabilities exceeded its assets by 256 million yen at the end of March 1996.
The company's earnings were hit by sluggish sales amid a slow economy, but began to improve from the second half of fiscal 1996/97, the statement said.
The company, however, is expected to post a net loss in 1996/97, the statement said.
